operations.summary: Delete a sub-account of the caller's tenant scope
operations.description: The user is disabled and marked deleted, every session is revoked at once (audited identity.tenant_member.delete). Refused for the owner, yourself and a user that also belongs to another scope. With transfer_to, the member's sites, layer-4 forward groups, certificates, security policies, URL authentication policies and own CC matchers/filters go to that member in the same transaction (audited identity.tenant_member.resources.transfer with the count per kind). Active package subscriptions, layer-4 forwards and sites bound to a package, a CNAME allocation or a live HTTP policy cannot change owner and always refuse the deletion; without transfer_to any owned resource refuses it. History (audit events, deleted resources, ticket messages, grant history) keeps the user ID; API keys and custom role grants stop working because they require an active user.

params.name: transfer_to
params.description: Active member of the same tenant scope that receives the resources.

responses.description: tenant_member_protected, tenant_member_shared or tenant_member_owns_resources (with the counts).
tenant_member_transfer_target_invalid (transfer_to is not another active member of the scope).

operations.summary: Require (or withdraw) a password change at the member's next sign-in
operations.description: While required, the member's session requests are refused with 403 password_change_required except GET /v1/auth/me and POST /v1/account/password; sign-in (with sign-in code, MFA and step-up as configured) is unchanged. Changing the password clears it. Audited identity.tenant_member.password_change.require / .release.

operations.summary: Give a sub-account a generated password (revokes its sessions, requires a change at the next sign-in)
operations.description: The generated password is kept encrypted for 10 minutes, bound to the caller and the Idempotency-Key. If the response was lost, sending the same request with the same key returns it once (replayed=true) without resetting again; afterwards the key answers 410.

responses.description: Reset (audited identity.tenant_member.password.reset) or the retained result retrieved once (identity.tenant_member.password.reset_result.retrieve). Cache-Control no-store.
tenant_member_password_reset_result_gone — the key's result was already retrieved, expired or replaced; nothing was reset.
tenant_member_protected, tenant_member_shared, or idempotency_conflict (the key belongs to another caller or member).

operations.summary: Suspend a member (revokes its sessions; its sites stop serving, see account_suspension)
operations.description: With transfer_to, the member's transferable resources first go to that member in the same transaction (see deleteTenantMember; audited identity.tenant_member.resources.transfer).
